Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing individual farms to participate in the women, infants, and children program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing individual farms to participate inthe women, infants, and children program; adding a new section tochapter 43.70 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall adopt rules authorizing individual farms toparticipate in the women, infants, and children program to providelocally grown, nutritious, unprepared fruits and vegetables to eligibleprogram participants.

If any part of this act is found to be inconflict with federal requirements that are a prescribed condition tothe allocation of federal funds to the state, the conflicting part ofthis act is inoperative solely to the extent of the conflict and withrespect to the agencies directly affected, and this finding does notaffect the operation of the remainder of this act in its application tothe agencies concerned. Rules adopted under this act must meet federal p. 1 HB 2793requirements that are a necessary condition to the receipt of federalfunds by the state.
